purpose: Guidance MCP regression cases. Run in Codex with the 0.3.0 plugin installed, once with the server reachable and once with it unreachable (plugin URL pointed at a missing path and the apps feature disabled, so no other route reaches the server). Not part of the 14-case quality benchmark.

cases.prompt: Prepare a Claude Code prompt: fix the flaky date-parsing test in utils/dates.test.ts without changing other tests or adding dependencies. Check the official guidance that applies first.
expected_observations: No call reaches the PromptingCraft.com guidance server and the answer says its guidance retrieval was unavailable
Replacement evidence is labeled by how it was actually obtained: live-verified with a date only if an official page was read in this run, otherwise dated cached
Nothing is attributed to a PromptingCraft.com live check
No-change remains available when the task body is already suitable

cases.prompt: Prepare a Claude Code prompt: fix the flaky date-parsing test in utils/dates.test.ts without changing other tests or adding dependencies. Check the official guidance that applies first.
expected_observations: search_guidance, get_guidance and check_source_freshness are called with fixed categories and ids only, never task text
Guidance is called live-verified only when check_source_freshness returned unchanged, with the check date
No-change remains available when the task body is already suitable
